issue.title: Don't send a scheduled export when the report is empty
issue.body:
Our daily "Refunds" export goes to four people every morning, including the
days when there were no refunds at all. Those emails say "(0 rows)" and the
attachment is just the header line. Could a schedule skip sending when there is
nothing in the report, or have an option for that? In a quiet week that's most
of the email we get from Ledgerline.

input.title: Skip scheduled export email when the report has no rows
input.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In runScheduledExport, after loading rows, skip building and sending the email when rows.length is 0 (either always, or behind a new optional schedule flag such as skipIfEmpty, which would also need adding to the schedule type and docs/API.md). Still call reportRepo.markScheduleRun with the next run time so the schedule advances and the report is not retried every tick. Consider not counting skipped runs in the "sent" total returned by runDueExports.

A maintainer said on an earlier request that "an empty export is still a useful signal for some teams," so an opt-in setting may be preferred. The change would go there. It would skip the send when the report is empty, still advance the next run time, and optionally be controlled by a schedule setting. I opened a draft PR (pr-16) that proposes this.
